papers.title: Revealing the intrinsic control mechanisms of quasi-static tensile and impact deformation in Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by laser powder bed fusion
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanics and Engineering Science, College of Engineering, Peking University, Beijing 100871, China

corresponding_authors.name: Jianhao Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanics and Engineering Science, College of Engineering, Peking University, Beijing 100871, China

corresponding_authors.name: Fan Feng
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanics and Engineering Science, College of Engineering, Peking University, Beijing 100871, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究了激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V的准静态拉伸和冲击变形性能，符合用户对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V力学性能的关注。
llm.why_not_core: 论文未涉及疲劳寿命或S-N曲线，主要关注拉伸和冲击变形机制而非疲劳性能。

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V在准静态拉伸和冲击载荷下的变形控制机制。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验表征和显微分析研究变形行为。
summary_zh.result: 识别了主导的变形机制和微观结构特征。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和冲击实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to reveal the intrinsic control mechanisms of quasi-static tensile and impact deformation in Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by laser powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: Experimental characterization and microstructural analysis were employed to investigate the deformation behavior.
summary_en.result: The dominant deformation mechanisms and microstructural features were identified.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through quasi-static tensile and impact testing.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Aerospace Engineering and Applied Mechanics, Tongji University, Shanghai 200092, China

papers.venue: International Journal of Solids and Structures

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是高温微动疲劳裂纹萌生，但未涉及增材制造，因此与本方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it focuses on fretting fatigue of conventional alloys at elevated temperatures without any AM context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究高温下Ti-6Al-4V和IN-100合金的微动疲劳裂纹萌生行为。
summary_zh.method: 建立了一个描述微动疲劳裂纹萌生的模型。
summary_zh.result: 模型能够预测合金的微动疲劳裂纹萌生行为。
summary_zh.validation: 未提及实验验证，可能为纯理论模型。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to model fretting fatigue crack initiation in Ti-6Al-4V and IN-100 alloys at elevated temperatures.
summary_en.method: A formulation is presented to describe the fretting fatigue crack initiation behaviour.
summary_en.result: The model predicts crack initiation under fretting fatigue conditions.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is reported; the work appears theoretical.
